assumptions: All graphs and digraphs are finite and simple unless the statement explicitly says otherwise.

definitions.definition: For every partition of V(G) into blocks of size at most r, there is a proper r-coloring whose colors are pairwise distinct on each block.
The maximum vertex degree in G.

domain.description: Finite simple graphs of positive maximum degree together with arbitrary partitions of their vertices into blocks of size at most 2Δ.

quantifiers.domain: finite simple graphs with maximum degree Δ≥1
partitions of V(G) into blocks of size at most 2Δ
proper 2Δ-colorings in which every block of P has pairwise distinct colors

statement.text: For every finite simple graph G with maximum degree Δ≥1, is G strongly 2Δ-colorable?

title: Strong colorability
